channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Former Qatar PM: Netanyahu using Iran war to reshape Middle East
item.description: Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim warns Strait of Hormuz crisis is most dangerous fallout of war on Iran, calls for 'Gulf NATO'.

item.title: Iran says US making ‘unreasonable’ demands in negotiations to end war
item.description: Foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei says Iran's proposal to end conflict, unblock Strait of Hormuz is generous.

item.title: Narendra Modi urges Indians to conserve fuel amid war on Iran
item.description: Narendra Modi urges Indians to conserve fuel amid war on Iran

item.title: Iran war day 73: Trump and Tehran clash over latest peace proposals
item.description: Brent crude rises amid a continuing deadlock as Trump describes Iran's response as 'totally unacceptable'.

item.title: Ex-Israeli PM: Hezbollah is the enemy of Lebanon and must be disarmed
item.description: Former Israeli PM Ehud Olmert speaks to Redi Tlhabi on Lebanon, the 2006 war, Hezbollah, and the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response “totally unacceptable”
item.description: Report on the latest developments after US President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s response to the US peace proposal.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
item.description: Iran is reported to want lifting of the US naval blockade, recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and compensation for war damage.

item.title: Ailing Iranian Nobel laureate given bail and hospital transfer
item.description: Iranian authorities granted human rights activist Narges Mohammadi bail amid growing concern over her poor health in prison.

item.title: Iran activists tell BBC how threat of war intensifies trauma of repression
item.description: A dissident in Tehran says she feels helpless and under immense psychological pressure.

item.title: Oil prices jump after Trump dismisses Iran proposal to end war
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz waterway remains effectively shut, severely disrupting global energy shipments.
